title: Pretty!
text: Pretty!. I just repainted my bedroom. I took down the cheap plastic mirror that was attached to the wall and decided I wanted something a little nicer. This is much nicer! It arrived safely. There was no assembly required. The stand is sturdy enough. I have it in the corner of my bedroom. I originally wanted to place it along the wall next to my closet but it does stick out a little more than I expected and I thought that could be potentially hazardous for me! I am very pleased with how it looks.
